about_the_game:
The main character, Jack, is a man who washes ashore after a storm. When he wakes up on a deserted beach, he finds himself alone among endless jungles and a silent ocean. While searching for water and shelter, he accidentally encounters a woman — a savage in a leopard outfit who lives in the heart of the island.
Her name is Tess. She seems to be part of this place: strong, wild, and mysterious. A primitive and dangerous attraction arises between them that requires no words.

With each passing day, their connection grows deeper. However, the closer Jack gets to her and her world, the more he realizes that no one ends up on this island by accident and that sometimes paradise hides the darkest desires.

Now, he must decide whether to find his way home or stay where nature itself calls him to sin.

Game features:
• An atmosphere of tropical paradise and isolation where passion becomes instinct.
• A story of survival, temptation, and the awakening of primal feelings.
• A mysterious heroine who is both wild and gentle.
• A visual style combining sensuality, beauty, and the danger of the jungle.
• Erotic scenes that contrast fear, passion, and silence.
